name: See3CAM_37CUGM

sources.title: See3CAM_37CUGM - 3MP Monochrome Sony IMX900 HDR Global Shutter USB3 Camera (e-con Systems product page)
sources.covers: sensor (Sony Pregius S IMX900), shutter, chroma, optical format, pixel size, active area, FOV with e-con's lens, focus, holder, output formats, frame rate, interface, operating voltage, size (l x b)

note: A monochrome global-shutter USB camera board (with e-con's M12 lens; an enclosure variant exists). FOV 111.91 (D) x 89.27 (H) x 65.03 (V) degrees "@ 2064 x 1552 Resolution (with lens provided by e-con)". The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Frame rate: "3MP @72 fps (8-bit)" and up to 838 fps with a custom ROI (firmware customisation); the page does not give the stream size of the "3MP" mode, so no stream is entered (the active area is 2064 x 1552). Output RAW 8-bit or 12-bit. Power "TBD" and weight "TBD" on the page: power_w and mass_g are null (not stated). size_mm is null: the page gives only "l x b" 30 x 30 mm, no depth. The full datasheet sits behind a download form and was not read. Not stated: f-number, focal length, distortion.

imagers.name: Mono
imagers.figures_conflict: The stated diagonal (111.91 deg) is wider than a centred, radially symmetric lens without pincushion distortion can show with the stated 89.27 x 65.03 deg across 2064 x 1552 px (at most about 108 deg): the three angles were probably not measured on the same image. The library uses the horizontal and vertical angles.
